title: The Brother Who Ran to Hug Him
reflectionQuestion: Jacob was so afraid, but Esau ran to hug him and forgave him. I wonder who you might want to hug, or say sorry to, or forgive?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Jacob category, Genesis 33). Pairs with 1900 Jacob's Ladder -> arc: God is with Jacob -> Jacob grows -> the brother he feared runs to hug him (grace in story form). WATCH-ITEM (Adam): let Esau's RUNNING HUG breathe -- that's the moment. The old hurt kept gentle/vague ('Jacob had done something that hurt Esau... had taken something that should have been his brother's') -- no deception details. Jacob models making things right: gifts, humble bowing, honest prayer. The HEART = forgiveness/grace; broken things can heal; the one you most fear to face may run to embrace you. Soft close ('hold you close'). VOICE_JAMES_HUSKY (ear-verified male; warm).
